origin: Designed here; nothing is extracted from any other game.
nonnegotiables: Soft low-poly water with a clear colour per spot; the water colour alone says where you are
Low camera behind a seated angler on a wet wooden pier (or boat deck); rod bends toward the line
Small underwater inset that shows depth, bait and the fish coming in
Warm Malay-first labels, big touch buttons, one main action at a time

sungai.mood: sunset with a lifting bridge silhouette

reference: Owner's concept image 'Sunset Pier Fishing Challenge': warm dusk, roofed pier, village on stilts, boats, seated angler in a songkok, bent rod, gradient tension bar. Mood and composition only; all geometry is built here.
